Christ Jesus. Lord we pray that our God would not be our stomach, our glory would
not be our shame, pray that you would take our eyes off of earthly things but
that we would know that our citizenship is with you in heaven and we pray that
But together we would wait for you, Lord Jesus, from there.
Lord, we thank You for the promise of Your Word.
We pray that You would give us the good gift of faith,
that we might know You in part today
until we see You in Your fullness.
Lord, we long for that day,
and we pray that we would long for that day together
and encourage one another until that great day.
So we pray all these things in the name of Jesus Christ, our Savior,
thankful that we can be found in Him. Amen.
